posts.headline: One press a night. Only as full as you earned.
posts.sub: Today reads 96%. Hold the wax and that is the impression it takes.
posts.shows: The home screen: a molten wax seal inside three arcs marked TRAIN, FUEL and BASE, with 96% and HOLD TO SEAL under it.
posts.angle: The whole app is one object. You press it once a night and it can only form as full as the day you had.
facts: Three arcs feed it: TRAIN, FUEL, BASE

posts.headline: Hold the wax. Feel it give.
posts.sub: It moves under your thumb and catches the light as you tilt the phone. The wax is a real Metal shader.
posts.shows: The seal mid press: the wax spreading and throwing off droplets while the day still reads 96%, HOLD TO SEAL.
posts.angle: The craft. The seal is a live surface that responds to touch and tilt, caught here half way through the press.
facts: The wax is a Metal shader
It responds to touch and to tilt

posts.headline: Then it sets. And the day is final.
posts.sub: Sealed, 96%, beat the plan. One press and the day is done.
posts.shows: The instant after the press: a ripple leaving the stamped seal, a gold ring round it, SEALED and 96% BEAT THE PLAN below.
posts.angle: Finality. One press and the day is closed.
facts: Sealed at 96%, marked BEAT THE PLAN
A gold ring means the day beat the plan

posts.headline: Beat the plan. The wax comes up gilded.
posts.sub: 100%, sealed at 21:12. Doing more never makes the seal bigger. It turns it gold.
posts.shows: A sealed day: the crimson seal stamped with a gold S and a gold ring, SEALED 21:12, 100% BEAT THE PLAN, and a SHARE THE SEAL button.
posts.angle: Overachieving is rewarded with gold, never with a bigger number.
facts: The seal caps at 100%; beating the plan gilds it

posts.headline: Sealed days lock forever.
posts.sub: Thursday: 98%. TRAIN 100, FUEL 99, BASE 96. No going back to tidy it up.
posts.shows: A sealed night opened from the wall: THURSDAY 12 NOVEMBER, 98%, TRAIN 100%, FUEL 99%, BASE 96%, 55 MIN, 435 KCAL, SEALED 21:32.
posts.angle: The seal cannot be edited after the fact. What you earned is what stays.

posts.headline: Short of perfect? 80% still holds.
posts.sub: It's evening and today reads 59%. The app says it plainly: push for 80% and the streak is safe.
posts.shows: The home screen in the evening with the day behind: 59%, an amber line reading SEALED STREAK AT RISK, PUSH FOR 80%, and TRAIN 60%, BASE 62%, FUEL 57% below.
posts.angle: Honest and kind at once: it tells you where you stand, and 80% is enough to hold the day and the run.
facts: 80% holds the day and the streak

posts.headline: Three arcs. One seal.
posts.sub: TRAIN, FUEL and BASE fill through the day. Press the wax once, in the evening. Not before.
posts.shows: The guide's YOUR DAY page: a sealed crimson seal with the day dragged to night, and three tiles: TRAIN 100% 4 OF 4 SETS, FUEL 100% 3 OF 3 MEALS, BASE 100% FILLS ITSELF.
posts.angle: The whole method on one card: tick training and meals, let Health fill BASE, press once at night.
facts: BASE 100%: fills itself from Apple Health

posts.headline: Wax, lava or liquid. Your colour.
posts.sub: Three forms and a shelf of colours: crimson, ember, forest, ocean, violet, plum, brass, slate.
posts.shows: The SEALED FX screen: FORM tiles for WAX, LAVA and LIQUID, and COLOUR pots named CRIMSON, EMBER, FOREST, OCEAN, VIOLET, PLUM, BRASS and SLATE.
posts.angle: The seal is yours to choose, and it previews on the real thing.
facts: 8 colours shown: crimson, ember, forest, ocean, violet, plum, brass, slate

posts.headline: Same seal. Poured in lava.
posts.sub: Today's 96%, molten. It still only forms as full as you earned.
posts.shows: The home screen with the seal set to lava: a glowing molten disc with cracked dark arcs, 96%, HOLD TO SEAL.
posts.angle: Same honest seal, different material.

posts.headline: Or liquid chrome. Gilded all the same.
posts.sub: 100%, sealed at 21:12, beat the plan. The gold is earned, whatever the seal is made of.
posts.shows: A sealed day with the seal set to liquid: a chrome disc with a gold S and gold ring, SEALED 21:12, 100% BEAT THE PLAN.
posts.angle: The look changes; the rule doesn't. Gold only appears when the day beat the plan.

posts.headline: Oil. Every colour at once.
posts.sub: Liquid, in oil: the surface turns through the spectrum as it moves. Today's 96%, waiting for the press.
posts.shows: The home screen with the seal set to liquid oil: a dark disc with bands of blue, violet and green moving across it, iridescent arcs, 96%, HOLD TO SEAL.
posts.angle: The craft. One of the liquid finishes is oil, which shifts colour as it moves.
facts: Oil is one of 8 liquid finishes
The seal is a Metal shader that responds to touch and tilt

posts.headline: Lava runs hot. In five colours.
posts.sub: Lava, blue, acid, violet and gold. Bottom right: the same lava sealed and gilded, white hot.
posts.shows: Six lava seals in a grid: molten in orange, blue, acid green, violet and gold, and one sealed with a white-hot gold ring.
posts.angle: Lava comes in five colours, and it glows hotter when the day is gilded.
facts: Lava has 5 colours: lava, blue, acid, violet, gold

posts.headline: Liquid metal. Copper to smoke.
posts.sub: Copper, gold, gunmetal, glass, rose and smoke. Each one sealed, so each one wears the gold ring.
posts.shows: Six sealed liquid seals in a grid: copper, gold, gunmetal, glass, rose and smoke, each with a gold S and a gold ring.
posts.angle: The liquid form is polished metal and glass, in eight finishes.
facts: Liquid has 8 finishes: chrome, gold, copper, gunmetal, oil, glass, smoke, rose
A gold ring means the day beat the plan

posts.headline: Classic wax. Pick your pot.
posts.sub: Ember, forest, plum, slate, violet and brass, all sealed and gilded. Crimson is where everyone starts.
posts.shows: Six sealed wax seals in a grid: ember red, forest green, plum, slate, violet and brass, each stamped with a gold S and ring.
posts.angle: The original wax, in a shelf of colours.
facts: Wax has 8 colours: crimson, ember, forest, ocean, violet, plum, brass, slate

posts.headline: Twelve seals. Which one's yours?
posts.sub: Wax, lava and liquid, in a few of their colours. All the same day, waiting for the press.
posts.shows: Twelve molten seals in a grid, one per finish: crimson wax, lava, oil, forest wax, blue lava, liquid gold, violet wax, acid lava, rose, brass wax, violet lava and glass.
posts.angle: The seal is the whole app, so it's yours to choose.

posts.headline: Hit the set? One tap.
posts.sub: Deadlift, 140 kg × 5: ticked. Barbell Row, 75 × 8, is next. No typing at any point.
posts.shows: A PULL session part way: Deadlift sets at 140 KG × 5 ticked lime, then BARBELL ROW set 1 at 75 KG × 8 still open, each showing last time's numbers.
posts.angle: Logging a set at target is a single tap, with last time beside it.
facts: A set at target is one tap; no keyboard

posts.headline: Off plan? Slide in real plates.
posts.sub: Hold the chip and slide: 80 kg on the bar. Bars step in plates, dumbbells in rack gaps, machines in stack pins.
posts.shows: Bench Press with its weight chip held: the 80 KG chip lit and a lens showing 80 KG above the finger, beside BAR PLATES, DUMBBELL RACK and MACHINE STACK, 4 SETS and 8 REPS.
posts.angle: Changing a weight is a slide in real gym steps. You never type a number.
facts: Bar steps in plates, dumbbell in rack gaps, machine in stack pins

posts.headline: Tick the set. The rest starts itself.
posts.sub: 1:25 left on this one. 3 of 10 sets down, and the timer runs on the lock screen too.
posts.shows: A PULL session with the rest timer counting 1:25 in the corner, 3/10 SETS and 30% EARNED, and Deadlift sets at 140 KG × 5 ticked.
posts.angle: The rest timer is automatic: tick a set and it runs.
facts: The rest timer also runs on the lock screen

posts.headline: Workout done. Every set kept.
posts.sub: 10 of 10 sets, 100% earned, locked. That's how days get sealed.
posts.shows: A finished PULL session: 10/10 SETS, 100% EARNED, a WORKOUT DONE card reading 'Every set kept. That's how days get sealed.' and LOCKED 11:16, with the Deadlift sets ticked below.
posts.angle: The micro-closure: TRAIN is complete and locked before the day's seal.

posts.headline: Cut it short? It locks as it stands.
posts.sub: 3 of 10 sets done. Hold to end, and the rest stay honest at zero.
posts.shows: The foot of a part-done session: FIVE-A-SIDE 60 MIN unticked with USE 55 MIN FROM HEALTH, then HOLD TO END · LOCKS AS IT STANDS and '3 OF 10 SETS · THE REST STAY HONEST AT ZERO'.
posts.angle: You can stop early, but the app won't round it up for you.
facts: Ending early locks the workout as it stands

posts.headline: Rate the session. Say a line about it.
posts.sub: Four stars and a spoken note: “Legs were heavy but every set landed.” Optional, always.
posts.shows: The RATE THE WORKOUT card: 4 of 5 stars, STRONG, a microphone and the note 'Legs were heavy but every set landed', LAST TIME 5 stars 'Best session in weeks', above HOLD TO COMPLETE & LOCK.
posts.angle: A star rating and a voice note so next week you remember how it felt.

posts.headline: Played five-a-side? It already counts.
posts.sub: From Apple Health: football 55 min, 510 kcal. Strength 48 min, 362 kcal. No entry needed.
posts.shows: The top of TRAIN: 10/10 SETS, 100% EARNED, a START CARDIO card (walk, run or match, clock runs on the lock screen) and FROM HEALTH · 103 MIN · 872 KCAL: STRENGTH 48 MIN 362 KCAL, FOOTBALL 55 MIN 510 KCAL.
posts.angle: Workouts recorded anywhere in Apple Health show up in TRAIN on their own.
facts: Cardio can be started in the app; its clock runs on the lock screen

posts.headline: Tick the meal. Skip the diary.
posts.sub: Omelette, 477 kcal: ticked. You name your meals once, then each day is a tap.
posts.shows: FUEL's MEALS & DRINKS list with every row ticked lime: 3 egg omelette with cheese on 2 slices of toast 477 KCAL, Lunch chicken, rice and broccoli 460 KCAL, Post-gym shake 128 KCAL.
posts.angle: Food is confirmation, not entry. Name your meals once and tick them.
facts: Omelette 477 kcal, lunch 460 kcal, shake 128 kcal
Meals are named once, then ticked each day

posts.headline: The plate fills as you eat.
posts.sub: 605 of 1,361 kcal part way through the day. 1,361 of 1,361 once every meal is ticked.
posts.shows: FUEL's plate twice, and the list under it. Left, part filled at 605 OF 1,361 KCAL with protein 56/144 g, carbs 40/91 g, fat 26/50 g; right, full and lime at 1,361 OF 1,361 KCAL with 144/144, 91/91 and 50/50 g. Below, the omelette (477 KCAL) ticked.
posts.angle: A plate that fills as meals are ticked: the same screen at midday and at night.
facts: Protein 144 g, carbs 91 g, fat 50 g on the plan

posts.headline: The maths is optional. And it stays on the phone.
posts.sub: This omelette: 477 kcal, 32 g protein, from egg, cheddar and white toast. UK food data, built in.
posts.shows: TODAY'S PLATE for one meal: '3 egg omelette with cheese on 2 slices of toast' and a MACROS row reading 477 KCAL · 32P · 37C · 24F · EGG · CHEDDAR · WHITE TOAST.
posts.angle: Macros are there if you want them, worked out on the device from UK food data.
facts: 477 kcal, 32 g protein, 37 g carbs, 24 g fat
Made of egg, cheddar, white toast
Uses UK CoFID food data, on the phone
A barcode scan can fill it in

posts.headline: Train today? It says: steady.
posts.sub: Readiness 68. Recovery high, heart normal, sleep strong. Train as planned.
posts.shows: BASE's readiness card: 68 in a ring, READINESS Steady, 'Train as planned.', with RECOVERY High, HEART Normal, SLEEP Strong.
posts.angle: A morning answer in plain words, worked out on the phone from Apple Health.
facts: Recovery high, heart normal, sleep strong

posts.headline: Last night: 88. And here's why.
posts.sub: 8h 16m against a 6h 30m target. Bed at 22:07, 27 minutes later than usual. Plain words, not jargon.
posts.shows: The SLEEP screen: 88, Strong, '8h 16m. Plenty of hours, a few wake-ups.', then WHAT MADE THE SCORE: Time asleep full marks (8h 16m, target 6h 30m) and Regular bedtime good (22:07, 27m later than usual).
posts.angle: A sleep score that shows its working.

posts.headline: BASE fills itself. Zero input.
posts.sub: Steps 4,067 of 5,000. Active energy 674 of 600. Apple Health already knows; Sealed just reads it.
posts.shows: BASE's signals: 3 of 6 hit, a red ring for STEPS at 4,067 of 5,000 and a lime ring for ACTIVE ENERGY at 674 of 600 kcal, +74.
posts.angle: The third arc needs nothing from you. It reads what Apple Health has.
facts: 3 of 6 signals hit so far today
Signals you can choose: steps, sleep, active energy, rings, stand hours, water

posts.headline: Seven nights. Seven hits.
posts.sub: Sleep averaged 8.2 hours against a 6.5 target. Steps hit 7 of 7 too: 11,281 a day.
posts.shows: BASE turned over to its history, LAST 7 DAYS: SLEEP HIT 7 OF 7 with an 8.2 average of 6.5 hrs, STEPS HIT 7 OF 7 averaging 11,281 of 5,000, ACTIVE ENERGY HIT 6 OF 7 averaging 687 of 600 kcal.
posts.angle: Every signal's week as bars against your own target.
facts: Sleep hit 7 of 7, average 8.2 of 6.5 hrs
Active energy hit 6 of 7, average 687 of 600 kcal

posts.feature: BASE: what to do with it
posts.headline: A score is no use without a next step.
posts.sub: Readiness 68, steady. Train: today's session stands. Tonight: bed by 21:42 keeps tomorrow steady.
posts.shows: The READINESS screen: 68, Steady, 'Train as planned.' on a scale from Ease off to Push, and WHAT TO DO WITH IT: 'Train · today's session stands.' and 'Tonight · bed by 21:42 keeps tomorrow steady.'
posts.angle: Readiness ends in an instruction you can act on.
facts: Tonight: bed by 21:42 keeps tomorrow steady

posts.headline: Every seal kept. Honest gaps included.
posts.sub: Streak 4, best 11, 2 mended. Gold rings mark the days that beat the plan.
posts.shows: THE WALL: SEALED STREAK 4, BEST 11, 2 MENDED, this week's seals, the run's marks 7 to 365, and NOVEMBER 2026 as a calendar of wax seals with one dashed mended day and one gold-ringed day.
posts.angle: History you can't rewrite: every sealed night, the gaps, and the days mended.
facts: One missed day a week can be mended

posts.headline: One week. One honest screen.
posts.sub: 4 of 5 sealed. 5 workouts. TRAIN at 93%. 20.0k kg moved.
posts.shows: THIS WEEK: four seals reading 93, 98, 88 and 98, then tiles for 4/5 SEALED, 5 WORKOUTS, 93% TRAIN and 20.0k KG VOLUME.
posts.angle: A week on one screen, with nothing rounded up.

posts.headline: 30 nights in a row.
posts.sub: Hold a month and the app stops to mark it. Then: keep going.
posts.shows: The milestone screen: a large crimson seal with a silver ring, 30, NIGHTS IN A ROW.
posts.angle: The run is marked when it's earned.
facts: A month's run turns the badge silver

posts.headline: Brass at a week. Gold at three months.
posts.sub: Bronze at 14, silver at 30, platinum at 60. The badge changes metal as the run grows.
posts.shows: The app's Sealed Streak badge at five marks, stacked: 7 in brass, 14 in bronze, 30 in silver, 60 in platinum, 90 in gold.
posts.angle: A streak that changes material as it grows.

posts.headline: You press at about nine.
posts.sub: Seals by weekday: Wednesday most. The wax goes down around 21:00. Your routine, drawn honestly.
posts.shows: Progress, THE HABIT: SEALS BY WEEKDAY bars with WED MOST, and WHEN THE WAX IS PRESSED, a single sharp peak at about 21:00.
posts.angle: The app shows the shape of your routine as well as the result.
facts: The wax is usually pressed around 21:00

posts.headline: Some streaks take two.
posts.sub: Day 13 with Alex. The pact only moves on the nights you both hold the day. Pact 4, best 4.
posts.shows: THE PACT: you and Alex, DAY 13 OF THE DUEL SINCE 1 NOV, PACT 4 · BEST 4, and two rows of nightly seals: yours 98, 65, 93, 98, 88, 98 and Alex's 86, 100, 91, 68, 94.
posts.angle: Two people, one streak. It advances only when both of you seal.
facts: The pact streak moves only when both hold the day (80% or more)

posts.headline: A nose in front. Never “you lost”.
posts.sub: 83–75 since day one, and Alex is near enough to hear you. Competitive, and always kind.
posts.shows: The duel: a banner reading 'A NOSE IN FRONT · 83–75 · ALEX'S NEAR ENOUGH TO HEAR YOU' and THE SCORE SINCE DAY ONE, 83 for you and 75 for Alex, THIS WEEK 95–88, WEEKS YOU 2, ALEX 0.
posts.angle: A head-to-head that never uses loser language.
facts: The duel is optional and always worded kindly

posts.headline: £3.99 a month. 7 days free.
posts.sub: One plan, everything included. A reminder on day 5, before it bills. Cancel any time.
posts.shows: The app's own offer page: 7 DAYS FREE, 'Then £3.99 a month. Cancel any time.', a timeline TODAY everything free, DAY 5 we remind you before it bills, DAY 7 £3.99 a month begins, and START MY FREE WEEK.
posts.angle: One price, said plainly, with a reminder before it bills.
facts: A reminder on day 5, before it bills
Everything you sealed stays on your phone either way

posts.headline: The seal, on your home screen.
posts.sub: Sealed, 100%, gold. Run 5, best 11. 6 of 6 signals hit and 20.0 T lifted this week.
posts.shows: Four of the app's widgets: THE SEAL reading SEALED 100% GOLD, RUN 5 NEXT 7; THE BASE with 6/6 SIGNALS; THIS WEEK with seals 94, 99, 88, 99, 100, RUN 5 BEST 11; THE WORK with 20.0 T LIFTED THIS WEEK.
posts.angle: The day's state without opening the app.
facts: Seal widget: sealed, 100%, gold; run 5, next mark 7
Work widget: 20.0 T lifted this week

posts.headline: The app that won't let you lie to yourself.
posts.sub: No retro-edits. No streak you didn't earn. One wax seal a night, only as full as the day.
posts.shows: A text card: the headline over three short lists headed Honest by design, Kind by design and Private by design.
posts.angle: The founding idea: a tracker you can't argue with, that is still kind.
facts: 80% holds the day and the run
Scheduled rest days seal by design
One missed day a week can be mended
Everything lives on the phone: no ads, no tracking, no email address
